meta.name: infinitetalk
meta.description: 自媒体创作者与内容创作者在制作数字人播报或视频配音时，只需输入单张人像与音频，即可自动生成唇形、表情、动作完美同步的无限时长说话视频。一键打造高质量虚拟主播内容，告别繁琐拍摄，让音视频创作更高效！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入人像和音频，自动生成数字人说话视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想快速制作虚拟主播视频而无需拍摄。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a portrait and audio into a talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create vtuber-style videos without filming.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调用脚本，用一张人脸图片或一段视频配合音频，生成唇形、表情、动作与音频对齐的说话视频；也能先从文本合成语音，再驱动生成。
howto.when: 当你需要制作数字人播报、视频配音或虚拟主播内容，或给出人像加音频要求生成说话视频时，它会接管。

say.text: 用这张人脸图片和这段音频，生成一个 480P 的说话视频
把这段文本转成语音，再让图中的人物说出来
say.note: 先用 Kokoro-82M 合成音频再生成视频

say.text: 用这段长音频生成无限时长的视频，走 streaming 模式

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can run the script to turn a single portrait photo or an existing video plus an audio track into a talking video whose lips, expression and motion follow the audio, and can also synthesize speech from text first.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need digital-human narration, video dubbing or virtual anchor content, or when you give a portrait plus audio and ask for a talking video.

say_en.text: Turn this portrait photo and this audio into a 480P talking video.
say_en.note: Runs the script and writes output.mp4

say_en.text: Convert this text to speech, then have the person in the image say it.
say_en.note: Uses Kokoro-82M TTS before video generation

say_en.text: Generate an unlimited-length video from this long audio in streaming mode.
